access_metadata.source_epoch: ETOPO 2022 composite; GLO90 mainly 2011-2015 plus gap fill; cover 2021 v200
access_metadata.sampling: ETOPO native 60 arcsec; overview 120 arcsec; ordinary detail 60 arcsec. Selected GLO90 DSM extracts at 6 arcsec; display 1/512 degree.
access_metadata.cover_sampling: Categorical COG: 225x225 per 3 degrees for broad areas, 2250x2250 for selected detailed areas. Unknown and water classes use neutral land material.
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern physical reference only; no 1900 cover, glacier, permafrost, water level, ownership or economic effects.
